 One extra ball. That’s what Rafael Jódar will have in his exciting journey through these ATP Finals 2026 . The priority is to gain experience and continue progressing as a tennis player, but the dream of qualifying for the semifinals is present and could be very close for the Spaniard if he manages to win his second match in Turin.
 He will face Arthur Fils , who comes off a loss against Shelton, although he put up a great fight. The Frenchman is also making his debut in this tournament and is aware that he needs to beat Jódar to keep his semifinal hopes alive. It won't be easy for the Frenchman, who has already experienced the greatness of the young Spaniard this season.
 Indeed, Jódar and Fils have met three times, with a favorable record for the Spaniard of 2-1 after his victories in Washington and Canada. It will be a spectacular clash between two players without a safety net at the ATP Finals 2026 , both in dire need of a victory to stay alive. 
 What time does Rafael Jódar play today against Arthur Fils at the ATP Finals 2026? 
 The match between Rafael Jódar and Arthur Fils, corresponding to the second day for both at the ATP Finals 2026, will take place this Tuesday, November 17, starting at 14:00h. It will be played in the morning session, so after this match, both the Spaniard and the Frenchman will be keeping a close eye on what Zverev and Shelton do in the other match in the group.
 Where to watch the Jódar - Fils match at the ATP Finals 2026 
 You can watch live in Spain on TV the match between Rafael Jódar and Arthur Fils at the ATP Finals 2026 via Movistar+ . The platform holds the broadcasting rights for the tournament and will offer the match on channel 64, available for customers with the Sports+ package, but those with the Basic package will also be able to watch it since it will be broadcast on channel 8 or #Vamos.
 Fans who want to watch live online the match between Jódar and Fils will have the option of using the Movistar+ app on computer, tablet, or mobile, as long as they have a customer username and password. The most universal option is TennisTV . All subscribers can watch the match in live streaming or on-demand from any device and anywhere in the world.
